title.narrative: Greening the future, advancing rights, regionalt program (Moldova, Georgien) - UNDP

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to support the Eastern Neighbourhood countries, in particular Georgia and Moldova, in adopting new development pathways towards green, inclusive and resilient economies and democratic governance.
The project has five outputs: Enhanced democratic local governance for inclusive and sustainable local development in two areas in Georgia through Area-Based Approach; Enhanced Governance in the Republic of Moldova through Multi-Stakeholder Engagement to Accelerate the Green and Inclusive Transition; Enhanced Regional Cooperation, Knowledge and Solutions for Accelerated Inclusive Green Transition and Inclusive, Anticipatory Governance; Strengthened Democratic Resilience in Moldova; Enhanced capacities of CSOs and media organizations to safeguard civic spaces in Georgia. UNDP is the implementing partner.

The project will contribute to Eastern Neighbourhood countries, in particular Georgia and Moldova, adopting new development pathways toward green, inclusive, resilient economies and democratic governance
The project has the following three components: i) Enhanced Democratic Local Governance for Inclusive and Sustainable Local Development in Two Geographic Areas in Georgia through the Area-Based Development Approach; ii) Enhanced governance in the Republic of Moldova through multi-stakeholder engagement to accelerate the green and inclusive transition and iii) Enhanced regional cooperation, knowledge and solutions for accelerated inclusive green transition and inclusive, anticipatory governance.
